workflows.name: Plan and revision lifecycle
steps: validate plan limits and zone name
append a strictly increasing immutable revision
activate only from draft with a matching version
complete only from active with a matching version
workflows.success: the plan becomes completed and preserves its revision history
workflows.failure: duplicate serials, stale versions, and invalid transitions return stable errors without state changes
workflows.verification: workflowprobe plan-revision-lifecycle creates, revises, activates, completes, and rejects a repeated transition

workflows.name: Node lease allocation
steps: validate the active plan and requested lease window
expire due leases and select ready nodes by region
mark nodes leased and create one bounded lease per node
workflows.success: each selected node receives one claimed lease and the request replay returns the same group
workflows.failure: unavailable nodes and request-key reuse with different inputs return conflicts without partial writes
workflows.verification: workflowprobe node-lease-allocation enrolls nodes, allocates a group, replays it, and rejects an exhausted allocation

workflows.name: Idempotent probe ingestion
steps: validate the claimed lease, request key, serial, latency, and time
persist one probe and complete the lease
return the original probe for an identical replay
workflows.success: one probe is stored, the lease becomes reported, and the node returns to ready
workflows.failure: expired leases, inactive plans, and same-key different-payload requests fail atomically
workflows.verification: workflowprobe probe-ingestion submits and replays a probe, then confirms conflicting content and release are rejected

workflows.name: Consistency assessment
steps: collect probes for the latest zone revision
calculate success ratio and maximum latency
persist the immutable verdict and update the plan summary
workflows.success: a deterministic consistent or review_required verdict is created and available as the latest assessment
workflows.failure: missing revisions, absent probes, request-key conflicts, and persistence errors produce no partial summary
workflows.verification: workflowprobe consistency-assessment creates consistent and review cases, retrieves the latest result, and checks replay
